project_scope.note: Start with Ashe juniper as the Central Texas anchor, then expand with eastern redcedar and other realistic local confusers.

priority: adult scale-leaf gland shape and position
study_strategy.warning: Habit and 'cedar-like' appearance are not enough. Use scale-leaf glands, cone characters and bark together.

quick_key.if: raised nearly circular/hemispheric resin gland on adult scale leaves + dark blue glaucous 6–9 mm cones
elongate/pitted gland tendency + generally smaller blue cones and red-brown bark
